items.title: Carolyn Buck Interview, 1969-03-25
items.q: isn't that the one that Jim... Bill Russell got? Jimmy Newman's?

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, that was the one he got for... That was the one I think that was supposed to be Jimmy Newman's band. Yes. Yeah.
No, I believe that... isn't that the one that Jim... Bill Russell got? Jimmy Newman's?
No, George himself got the Jimmy Newman one. Well, that's the one that he enjoys playing.
